answer: Escrowed reputation decay: each identity holds a saffron balance earned only through verified work, and that balance decays slower for older identities. A raven flag on any identity freezes a proportional slice of the escrow of every identity that transacted with it in the prior epoch. This makes each clone a spiral of shared liability, since fresh identities inherit thin escrow that drains fast under attack. An attacker running N identities must fund N decaying escrows plus the penalties cascading from any flagged cluster, so cost scales superlinearly with fleet size.
